data.name: North Star CCS
data.description: North Star Carbon Solutions LP is a dedicated BECCS project joint venture between Svante (via its acquired subsidiary Carbon Alpha Corp.) and the Meadow Lake Tribal Council, described as Canada's first majority Indigenous-owned CDR project. Phase 1 targets up to 140,000 tonnes/year of CO2 capture at the MLTC Bioenergy Centre in Saskatchewan, with roughly 90,000 tonnes/year of CDR credits sold to Microsoft under a 15-year 626,000-tonne offtake announced in April 2026. Final investment decision is expected in Q1 2027.
